kind.title: What is this Instagram account for?
kind.hint: So your tone and content ideas feel right.

name.title: What is your brand name and business category?
name.hint: The name that appears in your content, and what you do in a few words.

description.title: Tell us a little about your business.
description.hint: What you sell or offer, and what makes you different. 2–3 sentences is plenty.

audience.title: Who do you want to reach?
audience.hint: For example: moms aged 25–35 around Jakarta who enjoy easy home cooking.

posts.title: How often do you want to post each week?
posts.hint: This sets your content schedule and calendar. You can change it anytime on the Brand page.

style.title: What design style do you want?
style.hint: This is just a starting point for fonts and layouts. If you add design references or connect Instagram, those references will take priority.

fonts.title: Choose your design fonts.
fonts.hint: We’ve suggested fonts to match your style. Change them if your brand has its own.

referral.title: How did you hear about Carousely?
referral.hint: One last question, so we know how to reach more people like you.

done.title: All set! Here’s your brand style.
done.hint: You can change everything anytime on the Brand page.
